11188.html:
11188 vákṣas n. 'breast, chest' RV.
    Pk. vakkha-, vaccha- n. 'chest'; Sh.gil. baṣ m. 'lung', pales. bāṣ, jij. bāṣ (with low tone), kōl. bhāṣ; K. wach m. 'chest, bosom'; L. vakkhī f., (Ju.) vakhī f. 'side below the ribs', awāṇ. vakkhī 'sides'; P. vakkh, ba° f. 'the side', vakkhī, ba° f. 'side under armpit, rib', ḍog. bakhẽ adv. 'on the side of'; WPah.bhad. ḍḷakh, ḍhḷakh 'side'; H. bākh, bāk m. 'udder'. — Ash. wāš 'belly' (NTS ii 285) rather < ū́badhya-.
    Addenda: vákṣas-: Sh. and WPah. words wrongly attributed to vákṣas-: see †*bhaṣma-, †*bhāṣma-.
    *vagga- see vrájati.
